items.question: Trong câu "You already know the vocabulary: frontend, backend, API, JSON, database, SQL.", từ "vocabulary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You already know the vocabulary: frontend, backend, API, JSON, database, SQL.", what does "vocabulary" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the set of words used in a subject
items.explanation: vocabulary /vəˈkæb.jə.lər.i/ (danh từ): vốn từ, bộ thuật ngữ. Hay đi với "technical vocabulary" (thuật ngữ kỹ thuật).
items.explanationEn: vocabulary /vəˈkæb.jə.lər.i/ (noun): the set of words used in a subject. Common in "technical vocabulary".

items.question: Trong câu "The app is deliberately small so every file can be read in one sitting.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The app is deliberately small so every file can be read in one sitting.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách chậm rãi, thận trọng
một cách cố ý, có chủ đích
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): một cách cố ý, có chủ đích. Nghĩa khác: "chậm rãi, cân nhắc" (speak deliberately). Ở đây: cố tình làm nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose, intentionally. Another sense is "slowly and carefully" (speak deliberately). Here: small on purpose.

items.question: Trong câu "The app is deliberately small so every file can be read in one sitting.", từ "sitting" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The app is deliberately small so every file can be read in one sitting.", what does "sitting" (noun) mean?
options: một phiên họp chính thức của quốc hội
optionsEn: one continuous period of doing something
a formal session of a parliament
items.explanation: sitting /ˈsɪt.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): một lần ngồi liền (không nghỉ). "In one sitting" = làm liền một mạch. Nghĩa khác: phiên họp (a sitting of parliament).
items.explanationEn: sitting /ˈsɪt.ɪŋ/ (noun): one continuous period of doing something. "In one sitting" means without a break. Another sense: a session of parliament or a court.

items.question: Trong câu "The goal is literacy, not a career change.", từ "literacy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The goal is literacy, not a career change.", what does "literacy" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng đọc và viết chữ
sự hiểu biết cơ bản về một lĩnh vực
optionsEn: the ability to read and write
basic knowledge and skill in a field
items.explanation: literacy /ˈlɪt.ər.ə.si/ (danh từ): sự hiểu biết cơ bản về một lĩnh vực. Nghĩa gốc là biết đọc biết viết; mở rộng: "tech literacy", "data literacy" = hiểu biết cơ bản.
items.explanationEn: literacy /ˈlɪt.ər.ə.si/ (noun): basic knowledge and skill in a field. The core sense is reading and writing; extended: "tech literacy", "data literacy".

items.question: Trong câu "You will not learn to design a system from a blank page, tune performance or ship to production.", từ "tune" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You will not learn to design a system from a blank page, tune performance or ship to production.", what does "tune" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to adjust something so it works better
items.explanation: tune /tʃuːn/ (động từ): tinh chỉnh (cho chạy tốt hơn). "Performance tuning" = tinh chỉnh hiệu năng. Nghĩa khác: lên dây đàn (tune a guitar).
items.explanationEn: tune /tʃuːn/ (verb): to adjust something so it works better. "Performance tuning" is adjusting a system for speed. Another sense: tune a guitar.

items.question: Trong câu "A shared language with the team, which makes estimates and trade-off talks shorter.", từ "estimate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A shared language with the team, which makes estimates and trade-off talks shorter.", what does "estimate" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a rough calculation of effort or time
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (danh từ): ước lượng (công sức, thời gian). Động từ cùng dạng: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/. "Give an estimate" = đưa ra ước lượng.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (noun): a rough calculation of effort or time. The verb is pronounced /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/. "Give an estimate" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "A small comfort feature: the login form pre-fills the last email you typed.", từ "pre-fill" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A small comfort feature: the login form pre-fills the last email you typed.", what does "pre-fill" (verb) mean?
options: điền sẵn (trước khi người dùng gõ)
optionsEn: to fill in a field in advance
items.explanation: pre-fill /ˌpriːˈfɪl/ (động từ): điền sẵn (trước khi người dùng gõ). Hay gặp trong yêu cầu form: "pre-filled fields" = trường điền sẵn.
items.explanationEn: pre-fill /ˌpriːˈfɪl/ (verb): to fill in a field in advance. Common in form requirements: "pre-filled fields".

items.question: Trong câu "This table is the scope statement.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This table is the scope statement.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a viewing instrument, e.g. a telescope
the range of what a project covers
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi (công việc, dự án). "In scope / out of scope" = trong / ngoài phạm vi. Nghĩa khác: ống ngắm (microscope, telescope).
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the range of what a project covers. "In scope / out of scope". Another sense: a viewing instrument (microscope, telescope).

items.question: Trong câu "Everything outside it (password reset, email verification, sharing lists) is out of scope, and saying so explicitly is part of your job.", từ "verification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Everything outside it (password reset, email verification, sharing lists) is out of scope, and saying so explicitly is part of your job.", what does "verification" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the act of confirming something is true or valid
items.explanation: verification /ˌver.ɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự xác minh. "Email verification" = xác minh email (bấm link trong thư). Động từ: verify.
items.explanationEn: verification /ˌver.ɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the act of confirming something is true or valid. "Email verification" means clicking a link to prove you own the email. Verb: verify.

items.question: Trong câu "Everything outside it (password reset, email verification, sharing lists) is out of scope, and saying so explicitly is part of your job.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Everything outside it (password reset, email verification, sharing lists) is out of scope, and saying so explicitly is part of your job.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách rõ ràng, nói thẳng ra
optionsEn: clearly and directly, leaving nothing implied
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng, nói thẳng ra. Trái nghĩa: implicitly (ngầm). "Explicit" còn có nghĩa "nội dung nhạy cảm" (explicit content).
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and directly, leaving nothing implied. Opposite: implicitly. "Explicit" can also mean "sexually or violently graphic".

items.question: Trong câu "Before any code, a BA writes user stories with testable acceptance criteria.", từ "testable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before any code, a BA writes user stories with testable acceptance criteria.", what does "testable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to be checked by a test
items.explanation: testable /ˈtest.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): kiểm thử được. Một acceptance criterion tốt phải "testable": có kết quả quan sát được.
items.explanationEn: testable /ˈtest.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be checked by a test. A good acceptance criterion must be testable: it has an observable result.

items.question: Trong câu "Here are the ones this app satisfies.", từ "satisfy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here are the ones this app satisfies.", what does "satisfy" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to meet a requirement or condition
items.explanation: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (động từ): đáp ứng (yêu cầu, điều kiện). "Satisfy a requirement" = đáp ứng yêu cầu. Nghĩa khác: làm ai hài lòng (satisfy a customer).
items.explanationEn: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (verb): to meet a requirement or condition. "Satisfy a requirement". Another sense: make someone pleased (satisfy a customer).

items.question: Trong câu "As a new visitor, I want to create an account so that my to-dos are private to me.", từ "visitor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As a new visitor, I want to create an account so that my to-dos are private to me.", what does "visitor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: someone who comes to a website
items.explanation: visitor /ˈvɪz.ɪ.tər/ (danh từ): khách truy cập (chưa đăng nhập). Trong user story, "visitor" thường là người chưa có tài khoản, khác "user" đã đăng nhập.
items.explanationEn: visitor /ˈvɪz.ɪ.tər/ (noun): someone who comes to a website. In user stories, a "visitor" usually has no account yet, unlike a logged-in "user".

items.question: Trong câu "As a registered user, I want to log in so that I can see my to-dos.", từ "registered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As a registered user, I want to log in so that I can see my to-dos.", what does "registered" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: having signed up for an account
items.explanation: registered /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stəd/ (tính từ): đã đăng ký (có tài khoản). Nghĩa khác: "registered mail" = thư bảo đảm. Động từ: register (đăng ký).
items.explanationEn: registered /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stəd/ (adjective): having signed up for an account. Another sense: "registered mail" (recorded post). Verb: register.

items.question: Trong câu "As a logged-in user, I want to add, tick and delete to-dos so that I can track my work.", từ "track" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As a logged-in user, I want to add, tick and delete to-dos so that I can track my work.", what does "track" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to follow the progress of something
to follow the footprints of an animal
items.explanation: track /træk/ (động từ): theo dõi. "Track progress", "tracking tool" (công cụ theo dõi). Nghĩa gốc: lần theo dấu vết.
items.explanationEn: track /træk/ (verb): to follow the progress of something. "Track progress", "tracking tool". The original sense is following footprints.

items.question: Trong câu "As a user, I want my to-dos to be invisible to other users so that my data stays mine.", từ "invisible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As a user, I want my to-dos to be invisible to other users so that my data stays mine.", what does "invisible" (adjective) mean?
options: vô hình, không nhìn thấy được
items.explanation: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): vô hình, không nhìn thấy được. "Invisible to others" = người khác không thấy. Trái nghĩa: visible.
items.explanationEn: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (adjective): not able to be seen. "Invisible to others" means others cannot see it. Opposite: visible.

items.question: Trong câu "notice that half of the criteria are unhappy paths.", từ "unhappy path" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "notice that half of the criteria are unhappy paths.", what does "unhappy path" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a flow where something goes wrong
items.explanation: unhappy path /ʌnˈhæp.i pɑːθ/ (cụm từ): luồng lỗi / luồng ngoại lệ. Trái nghĩa: happy path (luồng mọi thứ suôn sẻ). BA cần viết tiêu chí cho cả hai.
items.explanationEn: unhappy path /ʌnˈhæp.i pɑːθ/ (phrase): a flow where something goes wrong. Opposite: happy path. A BA writes criteria for both.

items.question: Trong câu "In fs-10 you will verify each of them in the Network tab: 409 for a duplicate email, 401 for a wrong password, 400 for an empty title, 404 for someone else's to-do.", từ "verify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In fs-10 you will verify each of them in the Network tab: 409 for a duplicate email, 401 for a wrong password, 400 for an empty title, 404 for someone else's to-do.", what does "verify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to check that something is true or correct
items.explanation: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): kiểm chứng, xác minh. "Verify a token", "verify the result". Danh từ: verification.
items.explanationEn: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to check that something is true or correct. "Verify a token", "verify the result". Noun: verification.

items.question: Trong câu "In fs-10 you will verify each of them in the Network tab: 409 for a duplicate email, 401 for a wrong password, 400 for an empty title, 404 for someone else's to-do.", từ "duplicate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In fs-10 you will verify each of them in the Network tab: 409 for a duplicate email, 401 for a wrong password, 400 for an empty title, 404 for someone else's to-do.", what does "duplicate" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: exactly the same as another one
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdʒuː.plɪ.kət/ (tính từ): trùng lặp. "Duplicate email" = email trùng. Động từ duplicate /ˈdʒuː.plɪ.keɪt/ = nhân bản.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdʒuː.plɪ.kət/ (adjective): exactly the same as another one. "Duplicate email". As a verb (/ˈdʒuː.plɪ.keɪt/) it means to copy.

items.question: Trong câu "A criterion you can map to a status code is a criterion a tester can check without arguing.", từ "map" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A criterion you can map to a status code is a criterion a tester can check without arguing.", what does "map" (verb) mean?
options: gắn, ánh xạ (cái này với cái kia)
optionsEn: to draw a map of an area
to link one thing to a matching thing
items.explanation: map /mæp/ (động từ): gắn, ánh xạ (cái này với cái kia). "Map A to B" = ánh xạ A sang B. Nghĩa gốc: vẽ bản đồ.
items.explanationEn: map /mæp/ (verb): to link one thing to a matching thing. "Map A to B" links A to B. The original sense is drawing a map.

items.question: Trong câu "A criterion you can map to a status code is a criterion a tester can check without arguing.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A criterion you can map to a status code is a criterion a tester can check without arguing.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a standard used to judge something
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số nhiều bất quy tắc: criteria. "Acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí chấp nhận.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (noun): a standard used to judge something. Irregular plural: criteria. "Acceptance criteria".

items.question: Trong câu "The Vite proxy quietly forwards `/api` calls to Express.", từ "proxy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Vite proxy quietly forwards `/api` calls to Express.", what does "proxy" (noun) mean?
options: người được ủy quyền bỏ phiếu thay
bộ trung gian chuyển tiếp request
optionsEn: a person authorised to vote for another
a middle program that passes requests on
items.explanation: proxy /ˈprɒk.si/ (danh từ): bộ trung gian chuyển tiếp request. Nghĩa khác: người được ủy quyền (vote by proxy). Trong web: máy/chương trình trung gian.
items.explanationEn: proxy /ˈprɒk.si/ (noun): a middle program that passes requests on. Another sense: a person authorised to act for another (vote by proxy).

items.question: Trong câu "The Vite proxy quietly forwards `/api` calls to Express.", từ "forward" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Vite proxy quietly forwards `/api` calls to Express.", what does "forward" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to send something on to another place
items.explanation: forward /ˈfɔː.wəd/ (động từ): chuyển tiếp (sang nơi khác). "Forward an email / a request" = chuyển tiếp. Cũng là trạng từ "tiến lên" (move forward).
items.explanationEn: forward /ˈfɔː.wəd/ (verb): to send something on to another place. "Forward an email / a request". Also an adverb meaning ahead (move forward).

items.question: Trong câu "It is a library inside the Express process that reads and writes a single file.", từ "library" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is a library inside the Express process that reads and writes a single file.", what does "library" (noun) mean?
options: thư viện (mã nguồn dùng lại được)
optionsEn: a building with books to borrow
reusable code that a program includes
items.explanation: library /ˈlaɪ.brər.i/ (danh từ): thư viện (mã nguồn dùng lại được). Trong lập trình: "library" là gói code dùng lại (React, bcryptjs). Nghĩa gốc: thư viện sách.
items.explanationEn: library /ˈlaɪ.brər.i/ (noun): reusable code that a program includes. In programming, a reusable package of code (React, bcryptjs). Original sense: a book library.

items.question: Trong câu "It is a library inside the Express process that reads and writes a single file.", từ "process" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is a library inside the Express process that reads and writes a single file.", what does "process" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a running program on a computer
items.explanation: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (danh từ): tiến trình (chương trình đang chạy). Trong IT: một chương trình đang chạy. Nghĩa khác mà BA hay dùng: quy trình (business process).
items.explanationEn: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (noun): a running program on a computer. In IT, a running program. The sense BAs use more: a business process.

items.question: Trong câu "A few smaller libraries on the server do one job each: `bcryptjs` turns passwords into one-way hashes, `jsonwebtoken` creates the signed login token (a JWT), and `cookie-parser` reads the cookie on each request.", từ "hash" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A few smaller libraries on the server do one job each: `bcryptjs` turns passwords into one-way hashes, `jsonwebtoken` creates the signed login token (a JWT), and `cookie-parser` reads the cookie on each request.", what does "hash" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a one-way scrambled value made from data
items.explanation: hash /hæʃ/ (danh từ): chuỗi băm một chiều. Nghĩa khác: ký tự # (hash sign). Mật khẩu chỉ được lưu dưới dạng hash.
items.explanationEn: hash /hæʃ/ (noun): a one-way scrambled value made from data. Another sense: the # sign. Passwords are stored only as hashes.

items.question: Trong câu "A few smaller libraries on the server do one job each: `bcryptjs` turns passwords into one-way hashes, `jsonwebtoken` creates the signed login token (a JWT), and `cookie-parser` reads the cookie on each request.", từ "signed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A few smaller libraries on the server do one job each: `bcryptjs` turns passwords into one-way hashes, `jsonwebtoken` creates the signed login token (a JWT), and `cookie-parser` reads the cookie on each request.", what does "signed" (adjective) mean?
options: có chữ ký số (chống giả mạo)
optionsEn: carrying a digital signature that proves it is genuine
having a plus or minus sign (numbers)
items.explanation: signed /saɪnd/ (tính từ): có chữ ký số (chống giả mạo). JWT được "signed", không phải "encrypted": ai cũng đọc được nội dung nhưng không sửa được.
items.explanationEn: signed /saɪnd/ (adjective): carrying a digital signature that proves it is genuine. A JWT is signed, not encrypted: anyone can read it, nobody can alter it unnoticed.

items.question: Trong câu "The SQL is nearly identical across all three.", từ "identical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The SQL is nearly identical across all three.", what does "identical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: identical /aɪˈden.tɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): giống hệt nhau. "Nearly identical" = gần như giống hệt. "Identical twins" = sinh đôi cùng trứng.
items.explanationEn: identical /aɪˈden.tɪ.kəl/ (adjective): exactly the same. "Nearly identical". Also "identical twins".

items.question: Trong câu "Switching mostly means changing `server/src/db.js` and the query placeholders (fs-07): a small change that still needs retesting.", từ "placeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Switching mostly means changing `server/src/db.js` and the query placeholders (fs-07): a small change that still needs retesting.", what does "placeholder" (noun) mean?
options: chữ gợi ý mờ trong ô nhập
ký hiệu giữ chỗ trong câu SQL
optionsEn: grey hint text in an input box
a symbol that stands in for a value added later
a person holding a post temporarily
items.explanation: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): ký hiệu giữ chỗ trong câu SQL. Trong SQL: ?, $1 được thay bằng giá trị thật. Nghĩa khác trong UI: chữ mờ gợi ý ("What needs doing?").
items.explanationEn: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): a symbol that stands in for a value added later. In SQL: ? or $1 filled with real values. In UI: the grey hint text in an input.

items.question: Trong câu "Every choice is a trade-off.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every choice is a trade-off.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a balance between two good things you cannot fully have together
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Make a trade-off between speed and cost" = đánh đổi giữa tốc độ và chi phí.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two good things you cannot fully have together. "Make a trade-off between speed and cost".

items.question: Trong câu "When a team proposes a stack, ask what it costs to set up, to run and to change later.", từ "propose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a team proposes a stack, ask what it costs to set up, to run and to change later.", what does "propose" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to suggest a plan for others to consider
to ask someone to marry you
items.explanation: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (động từ): đề xuất. Danh từ: proposal (đề xuất). Nghĩa khác: cầu hôn (propose to someone).
